FX.title: [USD/JPY] UP: AI Detects Support at MA20 as Fundamentals Turn Bullish
tldr_points: China Q3 GDP and retail sales beat forecasts, boosting risk appetite.
PBOC sets USD/CNY reference rate weaker than expected, supporting USD strength.
Technical price sits above MA20 with RSI 62, indicating bullish momentum.
FX.excerpt: China's stronger data and PBOC's weaker CNY fix lift USD/JPY; price above MA20 with RSI 62 signals near‑term upside soon
FX.comment: China's stronger data and PBOC's weaker CNY fix lift USD/JPY; price above MA20 with RSI 62 signals near‑term upside soon

tldr_points: S&P 500 consolidates above key support as AI trade regains momentum.

Macro catalysts include strong earnings from mega‑cap tech and resilient US futures.
STOCKS.excerpt: S&P 500 poised for upside as AI momentum returns; technicals indicate bounce from MA20.
STOCKS.comment: S&P 500 poised for upside as AI momentum returns; technicals indicate bounce from MA20.
